change: Search-based confidence for the final code selected by the second opinion
limitations: The percentage measures search support using the existing candidate-card formula, not an independently calibrated probability of correctness.
A candidate selected against the search ranking may have a low or rounded zero score and stays needs_review.
Human corrections and remembered human decisions are separate sources and receive no invented model percentage.
The saved-results comparison is not a new live classification accuracy or latency benchmark.
